verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: verify Xenoverse 2 identity, cast exclusivity, costs, mechanics, and acquisition status. Preserve N/A unlocks and unsupported fields explicitly.
research_scope: Dragon Thunder — Strike Super / cast-exclusive research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation, character data, and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Dragon Thunder was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Dragon Thunder as a Strike Super and also lists it among Counter Skills and Unavailable for CaC skills.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Dragon Thunder is a cast-exclusive Omega Shenron Super Skill. It is not obtainable by the Future Warrior, so unlock_method and source_quest_or_shop are explicitly represented as N/A rather than fabricated.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required is null because there is no Future Warrior acquisition route to which an Ultimate Finish condition could apply.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100. Stamina cost remains null because no reliable canonical stamina value was established.

records.name: Dragon Thunder
records.skill_description: Omega Shenron extends the spikes on his back to impale an opponent above him, producing a short-range multi-hit Strike attack.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes Dragon Thunder as a short-range, anti-air, 16-hit, launching Strike Super. It can only connect when the opponent is above the user. Independent character data lists the same skill for Omega Shenron and his Supervillain version.
records.acquisition_notes: The skill is cast-exclusive and cannot be learned or obtained by the Future Warrior. Historical guides that list it as a skill-shop/PQ entry are treated cautiously because they conflict with current Xenoverse 2-specific cast-exclusivity documentation.
records.pve_notes: Cast-exclusive; no CaC acquisition route or Ultimate Finish requirement.
records.pvp_notes: Anti-air, short-range, launching behavior is documented; exact frame and matchup values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
